sentence: What do Harry Potter, Katniss Everdeen, and Frodo all have in common with the heroes of ancient myths?
translation: Điều gì đã làm nên Harry Potter, Katniss Everdeen, Họ có điểm gì chung với những vị anh hùng trong truyền thuyết?

fields.English:
What do Harry Potter,
Katniss Everdeen, and Frodo
all have in common with the heroes of ancient myths?
fields.Type: What do Harry Potter Katniss Everdeen and Frodo all have in common with the heroes of ancient myths
fields.Word_1: all have in common: idiomatic phrase
fields.Word_2: heroes of ancient myths: literary term
fields.Word_Example_1: What do these two novels all have in common?
fields.Word_Example_2: The heroes of ancient myths often embark on perilous journeys.
fields.Arabic:
المترجم: Mahmoud Aghiorly المدقّق: Anwar Dafa-Alla
ماذا يملك هاري بوتر،
و كاتنيس افردن،
أموراً مشتركة مع أبطال الأساطير القديمة ؟
fields.Chinese_CH:
哈利·波特
凯尼斯‧艾佛丁
这些角色和古代神话英雄有什么共同点？
fields.Chinese_TW:
哈利波特
凱妮絲‧艾佛丁
這些角色和古神話英雄有什麼共同點？
fields.French:
Qu'est-ce que Harry Potter,
Katniss Everdeen,
ont en commun avec les héros des mythes anciens ?
fields.Dutch:
Waarin lijken Harry Potter,
Katniss Everdeen
op de helden uit de mythologie?
fields.German:
Was haben Harry Potter,
Katniss Everdeen
mit Helden aus alten Mythen gemeinsam?
fields.Greek:
Ο Χάρι Πότερ,
η Κάτνις Έβερντιν
τι κοινό έχουν με τους ήρωες αρχαίων μύθων;
fields.Indonesian:
Apa kesamaan Harry Potter,
Katniss Everdeen, dan Frodo
dengan pahlawan dalam mitologi kuno?
fields.Italian:
Cosa Harry Potter,
Katniss Everdeen
hanno in comune con gli eroi delle antiche leggende?
fields.Japanese:
ハリー・ポッター
カットニス・エヴァディーン
この３人と 神話のヒーローたちとの 共通点は何でしょうか
fields.Korean:
해리포터,
캣니스 에버딘,
이들과 고대 신화에 나오는 영웅들 사이의 공통점이 뭘까요?
fields.Polish:
Co Harry Potter,
Katniss Everdeen,
mają wspólnego z bohaterami starożytnych mitów?
fields.Portuguese_BR:
O que Harry Potter,
Katniss Everdeen
têm em comum com os heróis dos mitos da Antiguidade?
fields.Portuguese_PT:
O que é que Harry Potter,
Katniss Everdeen, e Frodo
têm em comum com os heróis dos antigos mitos?
fields.Russian:
Что общего между Гарри Поттером,
Китнисс Эвердин,
и героями античных мифов?
fields.Spanish:
¿Qué tienen Harry Potter,
Katniss Everdeen
en común con los héroes mitológicos?
fields.Thai:
แฮร์รี่ พอตเตอร์
แคทนิส เอเวอร์ดีน
มีอะไรที่เหมือนกับฮีโร่จากตำนานกรีก
fields.Vietnamese:
Điều gì đã làm nên Harry Potter,
Katniss Everdeen,
Họ có điểm gì chung với những vị anh hùng trong truyền thuyết?

sentence: 11:00: Resolution All the tangled plot lines get straightened out.
translation: 11:00: Sự giải quyết Tất cả những âm mưu rối rắm được gỡ bỏ

fields.English:
11:00: Resolution
All the tangled plot lines get straightened out.
fields.Type: 1100 Resolution All the tangled plot lines get straightened out
fields.Word_Example_1: The Resolution resolves all conflicts in the story.
fields.Word_Example_2: The tangled plot lines were straightened out in the final chapter.
fields.Arabic:
11:00: مرحلة القرار
وهي المرحلة التي يستوعب بها كل الأمور التي مر بها و يصل إلى نتيجة و حكمة نهائية
fields.Chinese_CH:
十一点钟：解答
所有未解环节终于被一一解开
fields.Chinese_TW:
11點鐘：解答
所有未解環結終於被一一解開
fields.Dutch:
11 uur:   De oplossing
De verstrikte verhaallijnen worden afgewikkeld.
fields.German:
11:00 Auflösung
Alle verworrenen Teile der Handlung klären sich.
fields.Greek:
11:00: Επίλυση
Όλες οι μπερδεμένες γραμμές πλοκής ξεκαθαρίζονται.
fields.Indonesian:
Pukul 11, Penyelesaian
Setiap jalan cerita yang berliku kembali normal.
fields.Italian:
Le 11:00. La risoluzione.
Tutte le trame intricate vengono risolte.
fields.Japanese:
11時 解決
複雑な物語の筋が 解き明かされるときです
fields.Portuguese_BR:
11:00: Resolução
Todas as tramas do enredo são resolvidas.
fields.Portuguese_PT:
Onze horas: A resolução
O enredo fica desenredado.
fields.Russian:
11:00 — Заключение.
Все сюжетные линии проясняются, наступает развязка.
fields.Spanish:
11:00 Resolución
Todo el enredo de tramas queda enderezado.
fields.Thai:
11: 00 น. ความชัดเจน
ปมของเรื่องทั้งหมดเริ่มคลี่คลาย
fields.Vietnamese:
11:00: Sự giải quyết
Tất cả những âm mưu rối rắm được gỡ bỏ

sentence: Listen for your call to adventure.
translation: Hãy lắng nghe tiếng gọi đến với cuộc phiêu lưu.

fields.English: Listen for your call to adventure.
fields.Type: Listen for your call to adventure
fields.Word_Example_1: Listen for opportunities that signal your next step.
fields.Chinese_CH: 等待属于你的冒险故事的开始
fields.Chinese_TW: 等待屬於你的冒險故事開始
fields.Dutch: Luister naar je oproep tot avontuur.
fields.Greek: Αφουγκραστείτε το κάλεσμά σας για περιπέτεια.
fields.Japanese: 冒険への招待に耳をすませて
fields.Portuguese_BR: Ouça seu chamado para a aventura.
fields.Portuguese_PT: Escutem a chamada para a aventura.
fields.Spanish: Escuchen el llamado a la aventura.
fields.Thai: ฟังเสียงที่เรียกคุณสู่การผจญภัย
fields.Vietnamese: Hãy lắng nghe tiếng gọi đến với cuộc phiêu lưu.

sentence: However, muscles rely on more than just activity to grow.
translation: Tuy nhiên, ngoài vận động, cơ phát triển phụ thuộc vào nhiều yếu tố khác.

fields.English: However, muscles rely on more than just activity to grow.
fields.Type: However muscles rely on more than just activity to grow
fields.Word_1: rely on: collocation meaning depend upon
fields.Word_Example_1: Muscles rely on proper nutrition to develop.
fields.Arabic: مع ذلك، تعتمد العضلات على أكثر من مجرّد نشاط لتكبر.
fields.Chinese_CH: 然而，肌肉生长还要更多条件
fields.Chinese_TW: 然而，肌肉增長不只是 依賴助長生長的活動
fields.French: Cependant, les muscles ont d'autres besoins pour croître.
fields.Dutch: Toch rekenen spieren op meer dan enkel activiteit om te groeien.
fields.German: Allerdings brauchen Muskeln zum Wachsen mehr als nur Bewegung.
fields.Greek: Παρόλα αυτά, οι μύες δεν χρειάζονται μόνο δραστηριότητα για να αναπτυχθούν.
fields.Indonesian: Meski begitu, otot membutuhkan lebih dari sekadar aktivitas untuk membangunnya.
fields.Italian: I muscoli, però, non necessitano di sola attività fisica per poter crescere.
fields.Japanese: とはいえ 筋肉は 負担をかけるだけでは成長できません
fields.Korean: 하지만 근육이 자라는데 단지 활동만이 필요한 것은 아닙니다.
fields.Polish: Do wzrostu mięśni aktywność nie wystarczy.
fields.Portuguese_BR: No entanto, músculos dependem de mais do que apenas atividades para crescer.
fields.Portuguese_PT: No entanto, para crescerem, os músculos não dependem só da atividade.
fields.Russian: Но для роста мышцам требуется не одна только активность.
fields.Spanish: No obstante, los músculos requieren más que actividad para crecer.
fields.Thai: อย่างไรก็ดี การเติบโตของกล้ามเนื้อต้อง อาศัยปัจจัยอื่นอีก นอกจากแค่การออกกำลัง
fields.Vietnamese: Tuy nhiên, ngoài vận động, cơ phát triển phụ thuộc vào nhiều yếu tố khác.

sentence: It's not the absurdity of bureaucracy alone, but the irony of the character's circular reasoning in reaction to it that is emblematic of Kafka's writing.
translation: Không chỉ có sự phi lý của bộ máy quan liêu, mà sự trớ trêu của lý luận vòng quanh trong phản ứng với bộ máy đó mới là đặc trưng của văn Kafka.

fields.English:
It's not the absurdity of bureaucracy alone,
but the irony of the character's circular reasoning in reaction to it
that is emblematic of Kafka's writing.
fields.Type: Its not the absurdity of bureaucracy alone but the irony of the characters circular reasoning in reaction to it that is emblematic of Kafkas writing
fields.Word_1: circular reasoning: collocation meaning illogical argument returning to itself
fields.Word_2: emblematic of: collocation meaning symbolic of
fields.Word_Example_1: The politician's circular reasoning frustrated the audience.
fields.Word_Example_2: The dove is emblematic of peace.
fields.Arabic:
إنها ليست عبثية من البيروقراطية وحدها،
لكن المفارقة في شخصياتها تكمن في الأسلوب الملتوي لردات فعلها
وهذه هي رمزية الكتابة لكافكا.
fields.Chinese_CH:
不是官僚主义本身的荒谬
而是角色在对官僚主义反应上的 围绕式推理的讽刺
成为了卡夫卡作品的典型
fields.Chinese_TW:
它不僅反映了官僚體制的荒謬，
更諷刺了故事角色在面對 惡行循環時的反應。
這就是典型的卡夫卡作品。
fields.French:
Ce n'est pas uniquement l'absurdité de la bureaucratie,
mais l'ironie du raisonnement circulaire du personnage en réaction à celle-ci
qui illustre bien l’écriture de Kafka.
fields.Greek:
Δεν είναι μόνο το παράλογο της γραφειοκρατίας
αλλά και η ειρωνεία της κυκλικής λογικής του πρωταγωνιστή σε αντίδραση αυτού,
που είναι συμβολικό της γραφής του Κάφκα.
fields.Indonesian:
Bukan hanya birokrasi yang tidak masuk akal,
tapi ironi dari alasan dari sang tokoh dalam bereaksi akan hal tersebutlah
yang menjadi pusat cerita Kafka.
fields.Italian:
Non è solo l'assurdità della burocrazia,
ma l'ironia del ragionamento circolare del personaggio in reazione ad essa
ciò che rende emblematico Kafka.
fields.Japanese:
つまり官僚制度の バカバカしさだけでなく
それに対する主人公の 循環論理という皮肉が
カフカの作品の象徴なのです
fields.Korean:
이것은 관료제의 모순만 담고 있는 것이 아닙니다.
이는 카프카의 글에서 암시적으로 보이는
fields.Polish:
Nie tylko absurdalność biurokracji,
ale błędne koło w rozumowaniu, w które wpada bohater,
jest charakterystyczne dla prozy Kafki.
fields.Portuguese_BR:
Não é apenas o absurdo da burocracia,
mas a ironia de o personagem montar uma linha de raciocínio que leve a isto
que é o emblema das obras de Kafka.
fields.Portuguese_PT:
Não é só o absurdo da burocracia,
é a ironia do raciocínio circular do personagem em relação a isso
que é emblemática da escrita de Kafka.
fields.Russian:
Это не только бюрократический абсурд,
но и ирония, скрытая в алогичности реакций персонажей,
что отличает работы Кафки.
fields.Spanish:
No es lo absurdo de la burocracia por sí sola,
sino la ironía del razonamiento circular del personaje en reacción a él
que es un emblema de la escritura de Kafka.
fields.Vietnamese:
Không chỉ có sự phi lý của bộ máy quan liêu,
mà sự trớ trêu của lý luận vòng quanh trong phản ứng với bộ máy đó
mới là đặc trưng của văn Kafka.

sentence: They were the victims of paranoia about the supernatural, misdirected religious fervor— and a justice system that valued repentance over truth.
translation: Họ là nạn nhân của chứng hoang tưởng về siêu nhiên, những niềm tin sai lệch trong tín ngưỡng— và một hệ thống công lý coi trọng sự ăn năn hối cải hơn sự thật.

fields.English:
They were the victims of paranoia about the supernatural,
misdirected religious fervor—
and a justice system that valued repentance over truth.
fields.Type: They were the victims of paranoia about the supernatural misdirected religious fervor— and a justice system that valued repentance over truth
fields.Word_1: victims of: collocation meaning sufferers of
fields.Word_2: misdirected religious fervor: phrase meaning wrongly intense devotion
fields.Word_3: valued repentance over truth: collocation describing biased justice
fields.Word_Example_1: Many were victims of propaganda during the war.
fields.Word_Example_2: His misdirected religious fervor led to conflict.
fields.Word_Example_3: The court valued repentance over truth in sentencing.
fields.Arabic:
كانوا ضحيةً للخوف المبالغ فيه من القوى الخارقة للطبيعة،
وُجه بشكلٍ خاطىء بحماسةٍ دينية...
حيث كان نظام العدالة القائم يفضل التوبة على الحقيقة.
fields.Chinese_CH:
他们是对超自然力量的迫害妄想的受害者，
是被误导的宗教狂热的受害者，
也是当时重视忏悔 甚于真相的司法系统的牺牲品。
fields.Chinese_TW:
他們都是受害者，原因是 人們對超自然力量的偏執、
誤導的宗教熱情——
以及重視悔改多於真相的司法體制。
fields.French:
Ils étaient victimes
de la bigoterie
et d'un système pénal qui préférait
fields.Dutch:
Zij waren het slachtoffer van paranoia over het bovennatuurlijke,
verkeerd gerichte religieuze hartstocht --
en een rechtssysteem dat boeten boven de waarheid stelde.
fields.Greek:
Ήταν θύματα μιας παράνοιας σχετικά με το υπερφυσικό,
αποπροσανατολισμένου θρησκευτικού ζήλου -
και ενός δικαστικού συστήματος που προτιμούσε τη μετάνοια από την αλήθεια.
fields.Indonesian:
Mereka adalah korban paranoia kekuatan gaib,
ketaatan agama yang salah arah—
dan sistem peradilan yang mementingkan pertobatan di atas kebenaran.
fields.Italian:
Furono vittime della paranoia verso il paranormale,
dell'uso improprio del fervore religioso, e di un sistema giudiziario
fields.Japanese:
彼らは 超自然的なものに対する妄想や
宗教的な迷信
真実よりも改悔を正義とするシステムの 被害者です
fields.Korean:
그들은 초자연적인 현상에 대한 편집증과
잘못된 종교적 열정
그리고 회개를 진실보다 우선시하는 판결 시스템의 희생자들이었습니다.
fields.Polish:
Byli ofiarami paranoi
i systemu sprawiedliwości, który wolał skruchę od prawdy.
fields.Portuguese_BR:
Eles eram vítimas da obsessão pelo sobrenatural,
de um fervor religioso mal direcionado
e um sistema judicial que dava mais valor ao arrependimento do que à verdade.
fields.Portuguese_PT:
As pessoas foram vítimas da paranoia quanto ao sobrenatural,
de um fervor religioso mal orientado
e de um sistema de justiça
fields.Russian:
Они стали жертвами паранойи, вызванной необъяснимыми явлениями,
слишком далеко зашедшим религиозным рвением
и несовершенством судебной системы, ценившей покаяние превыше правды.
fields.Spanish:
Se trató de víctimas de la paranoia en torno a lo sobrenatural,
de un fervor religioso contraproducente
y de un sistema de justicia que valoraba más el arrepentimiento que la verdad.
fields.Thai:
พวกเขาตกเป็นเหยื่อของความหวาดระแวง เกี่ยวกับสิ่งเหนือธรรมชาติ
ความศรัทธาอันแรงกล้าทางศาสนาในทางที่ผิด
และ ระบบความยุติธรรมที่เห็นคุณค่า การสำนึกบาปมากกว่าความจริง
fields.Vietnamese:
Họ là nạn nhân của chứng hoang tưởng về siêu nhiên,
những niềm tin sai lệch trong tín ngưỡng—
và một hệ thống công lý coi trọng sự ăn năn hối cải hơn sự thật.

sentence: Those who dared to speak out, such as Judge Nathanial Saltonstall, came under suspicion.
translation: Những người dám lên tiếng, như Thẩm phán Nathanial Saltonstall, bị nghi ngờ.

fields.English:
Those who dared to speak out, such as Judge Nathanial Saltonstall,
came under suspicion.
fields.Type: Those who dared to speak out such as Judge Nathanial Saltonstall came under suspicion
fields.Word_1: dared to: collocation meaning had courage to
fields.Word_2: came under suspicion: phrase meaning became suspected
fields.Word_Example_1: Few dared to challenge the government openly.
fields.Word_Example_2: The politician came under suspicion of corruption.
fields.Arabic:
وأولئك الذين تجرؤا وتحدثوا، كالقاضي ناثانيال سالتونستال،
صاروا موضع شبهة.
fields.Chinese_CH:
那些胆敢发声质疑的人， 比如法官纳撒尼尔 · 索顿斯托尔，
反而遭到了怀疑。
fields.Chinese_TW:
敢說出來的人，比如 納森尼爾·索頓斯托爾法官，
則受到懷疑。
fields.Dutch:
Zij die zich durfden verzetten,
werden in verdenking gesteld.
fields.Greek:
Όσοι τολμούσαν να φέρουν αντίρρηση, όπως ο Δικαστής Ναθάνιελ Σαλτόνσταλ,
γινόντουσαν ύποπτοι.
fields.Indonesian:
Bagi yang berani berbicara, seperti Hakim Nathanial Saltonstall,
turut dicurigai.
fields.Italian:
Chi osava dire la propria, come il giudice Nathanial Saltonstall,
risultava sospetto.
fields.Japanese:
ナサニエル・サルトンストール判事のように あえて声を上げた人たちは
容疑をかけられました
fields.Korean:
판사 나다니엘 살튼스톨과 같이 누군가가 이 사안에 감히 문제를 토로한다면
의심을 받았습니다.
fields.Polish:
Ci, którzy odważyli się zabrać głos, jak sędzia Nathanial Saltonstall,
sami stali się podejrzani.
fields.Portuguese_BR:
Aqueles que ousavam opinar, como o juiz Nathanial Saltonstall,
eram vistos como suspeitos.
fields.Portuguese_PT:
Os que se atreviam a protestar abertamente
passavam a ser suspeitos.
fields.Spanish:
Quienes se atrevían a hablar, como el juez Nathanial Saltonstall,
se consideraban sospechosos.
fields.Thai:
ผู้ที่กล้าโต้แย้งออกมา อย่างผู้พิพากษา นาธานเนียล ซอลตันสตอลล์
ถูกต้องสงสัย
fields.Vietnamese:
Những người dám lên tiếng, như Thẩm phán Nathanial Saltonstall,
bị nghi ngờ.

sentence: Increased dehydration can cause notable drops in energy, mood, skin moisture, and blood pressure, as well as signs of cognitive impairment.
translation: Sự thiếu nước trầm trọng có thể gây thiếu hụt năng lượng, tâm trạng không tốt, da khô, giảm huyết áp, và các dấu hiệu suy giảm nhận thức.

fields.English:
Increased dehydration can cause notable drops in energy,
mood,
skin moisture,
and blood pressure,
as well as signs of cognitive impairment.
fields.Type: Increased dehydration can cause notable drops in energy mood skin moisture and blood pressure as well as signs of cognitive impairment
fields.Word_1: notable drops in: phrase meaning significant decreases
fields.Word_2: cognitive impairment: phrase meaning reduced mental function
fields.Word_Example_1: Cold weather can cause notable drops in temperature.
fields.Word_Example_2: Sleep deprivation may lead to cognitive impairment.
fields.Arabic:
زيادة الجفاف قد تؤدي الى انخفاض في الطاقة.
المزاج،
رطوبة الجلد ،
و ضغط الدم ،
و أيضاً ضعف الإدراك .
fields.Chinese_CH:
加重的脱水能引起 明显的乏力、情绪低落、
皮肤干燥
和血压降低
以及认知障碍。
fields.Chinese_TW:
脫水加重會造成明顯的精力減退
心情不振
皮膚變乾
低血壓
以及認知障礙的症狀
fields.French:
Une déshydratation accrue peut provoquer des baisses d'énergie,
des sautes d'humeur,
une sécheresse cutanée,
une chute de tension artérielle,
ainsi que des signes de déficience cognitive.
fields.Dutch:
Voortgeschreden uitdroging leidt tot opmerkelijk verlies van energie,
een slecht humeur,
een droge lichaamshuid
en een lage bloeddruk,
evenals belemmering van de cognitieve vermogens.
fields.German:
Ein höherer Wasserverlust kann zu einem merkbaren Abfall der Energie,
Stimmung, Hautfeuchtigkeit
und des Blutdrucks
sowie Anzeichen einer kognitiven Beeinträchtigung führen.
fields.Greek:
Η αυξημένη αφυδάτωση μπορεί να προκαλέσει σημαντική μείωση ενέργειας,
διάθεσης,
ενυδάτωσης του δέρματος
και της αρτηριακής πίεσης,
καθώς και ενδείξεις γνωστικής εξασθένησης.
fields.Indonesian:
Dehidrasi berlebih berpengaruh pada menurunnya energi,
suasana hati
kelembaban kulit,
dan tekanan darah,
juga gangguan kognitif.
fields.Italian:
La disidratazione può causare notevoli cali d'energia,
d'umore,
d'idratazione della pelle,
e di pressione sanguigna
così come segni d'indebolimento cognitivo.
fields.Japanese:
脱水状態が進行すると 元気がなくなり
気分
肌の水分
血圧の低下が
思考力低下と共に発現します
fields.Korean:
탈수가 심해지면 체력과 기분, 피부 수분
혈압이 눈에띄게 저하될 수 있습니다,
인지장애의 증상은 말할 것도 없지요.
fields.Malay:
Penyahhidratan boleh menyebabkan penurunan tenaga yang ketara,
emosi,
kelembapan kulit,
dan tekanan darah,
serta tanda-tanda gangguan kognitif.
fields.Polish:
Dalsze odwodnienie może powodować znaczne spadki energii,
nastroju,
nawilżenia skóry
i ciśnienia krwi,
jak i zaburzenie funkcji poznawczych.
fields.Russian:
Продолжающееся обезвоживание может вызвать значительную потерю энергии,
ухудшение настроения,
сухость кожи,
снижение кровяного давления,
а также привести к появлению признаков когнитивных расстройств.
fields.Spanish:
Una elevada deshidratación puede causar notables descensos del nivel de energía,
humor,
hidratación de la piel,
y presión sanguínea,
así como signos de deterioro cognitivo.
fields.Thai:
การขาดน้ำที่เพิ่มมากขึ้น สามารถก่อให้เกิดการลดต่ำลงของพลังงาน
อารมณ์
ความชุ่มชื้นของผิว
และความดันเลือด
เช่นเดียวกันกับสัญญาณการรับรู้ ต่อการซ่อมแซมส่วนที่สึกหรอ
fields.Vietnamese:
Sự thiếu nước trầm trọng có thể gây thiếu hụt năng lượng,
tâm trạng không tốt, da khô,
giảm huyết áp, và các dấu hiệu suy giảm nhận thức.

fields.Word_1: dream to remember: phrase meaning purpose of memory consolidation
fields.Word_Example_1: Students dream to remember new information learned during the day.
fields.German: Wir träumen, um uns zu erinnern.
fields.Japanese: 我々は記憶するために夢を見ます
fields.Thai: เราฝันเพื่อที่จะจำ

sentence: And those are just a few of the more prominent theories.
translation: Trên đây chỉ là một số trong nhiều giả thuyết nổi bật.

fields.English: And those are just a few of the more prominent theories.
fields.Type: And those are just a few of the more prominent theories
fields.Word_1: prominent theories: phrase meaning notable ideas or hypotheses
fields.Word_Example_1: Evolution and relativity are prominent theories in science.
fields.Arabic: وماهذه النظريات إلا عدد قليل من نظريات كثيرة بارزة
fields.Chinese_CH: 这里也有一些更为突出的理论。
fields.Chinese_TW: 而這些只是一部份較著名的理論
fields.French: Ce ne sont que quelques-unes des théories les plus dominantes.
fields.German: Und dies sind nur einige der bekannteren Theorien.
fields.Greek: Κι αυτές είναι μόνο μερικές από τις κυριότερες θεωρίες.
fields.Indonesian: Teori-teori tadi hanya secuil dari begitu banyak teori yang ada.
fields.Italian: E queste sono solo alcune delle più illustri teorie.
fields.Japanese: 他にも さらに際立った理論があります
fields.Polish: To tylko kilka z wybitnych teorii.
fields.Portuguese_BR: E essas são apenas algumas das teorias mais proeminentes.
fields.Portuguese_PT: Estas são apenas algumas das teorias mais predominantes.
fields.Russian: Это всего лишь некоторые из теорий сна.
fields.Spanish: Estas son solo algunas de las teorías más prominentes.
fields.Thai: และทั้งหมดนี้เป็นแค่ส่วนหนึ่ง ของทฤษฏีต่าง ๆ ที่มีชื่อเสียง
fields.Vietnamese: Trên đây chỉ là một số trong nhiều giả thuyết nổi bật.

sentence: And some of the largest solar plants in the world are trying a new approach: giant mirrors.
translation: Một vài trạm năng lượng lớn nhất thế giới đang cố gắng thử một cách mới: những tấm gương khổng lồ.

fields.English:
And some of the largest solar plants in the world are trying a new approach:
giant mirrors.
fields.Type: And some of the largest solar plants in the world are trying a new approach giant mirrors
fields.Word_1: the largest…in the world: superlative structure
fields.Word_2: trying a new approach: collocation for innovation
fields.Word_Example_1: It’s the largest library in the world.
fields.Word_Example_2: The company is trying a new approach to customer service.
fields.Word_Example_3: The temple was decorated with giant mirrors reflecting sunlight.
fields.Arabic:
فبعض أكبر محطات الطاقة الشمسية في العالم تجرب نهجا جديدا:
مرايا عملاقة.
fields.Chinese_HK:
世界最大嘅幾個太陽能發電站 正喺度嘗試一個新方法
巨型鏡子
fields.Chinese_CH:
世界上一些最大的太阳能发电厂 正在尝试一种新方法：
巨型镜子。
fields.Chinese_TW:
世界上一些大型的大陽能電廠 正試著一個全新的方案：
巨大的鏡子。
fields.French:
Une nouvelle approche est testée par certaines des plus grandes implantations :
des miroirs géants.
fields.Greek:
Μερικές από τις μεγαλύτερες μονάδες στον κόσμο δοκιμάζουν μια νέα προσέγγιση:
γιγαντιαία κάτοπτρα.
fields.Hindi:
और दुनिया में कुछ सबसे बड़ी सौर योजनाएँ एक नया नजरिया अपना रही हैं:
बहुत बड़े आईने।
fields.Indonesian:
Beberapa pembangkit tenaga surya di dunia sedang mencoba cara baru:
cermin raksasa.
fields.Italian:
E alcuni dei più grandi impianti solari del mondo ne stanno provando una nuova:
specchi giganti.
fields.Japanese:
そして世界最大級の太陽光発電所では 新たなアプローチを試みています
巨大な鏡です
fields.Korean:
세계 최대 태양광 발전소 중 몇몇은 새로운 시도를 해보고 있는데,
이는 바로 거대한 거울입니다.
fields.Polish:
Niektóre z największych farm solarnych testują nowe rozwiązanie,
ogromne lustra.
fields.Portuguese_BR:
Algumas das maiores usinas solares do mundo
espelhos gigantes.
fields.Portuguese_PT:
Algumas das maiores centrais solares do mundo
espelhos gigantes.
fields.Russian:
На некоторых крупнейших СЭС в мире применяют новый подход
гигантские зеркала.
fields.Spanish:
Algunas de las plantas más grandes del mundo
espejos gigantes.
fields.Thai:
และโรงผลิตไฟฟ้าขนาดใหญ่บางแห่ง กำลังลองใช้วิธีใหม่
กระจกยักษ์
fields.Vietnamese:
Một vài trạm năng lượng lớn nhất thế giới đang cố gắng thử một cách mới:
những tấm gương khổng lồ.

sentence: Procrastination is when we avoid a task we said we would do, for no good reason, despite expecting our behavior to bring negative consequences.
translation: Trì hoãn tức là tránh không làm điều ta bảo sẽ làm, biết rằng hành vi này sẽ gây ra hậu quả xấu.

fields.English:
Procrastination is when we avoid a task we said we would do, for no good reason,
despite expecting our behavior to bring negative consequences.
fields.Type: Procrastination is when we avoid a task we said we would do for no good reason despite expecting our behavior to bring negative consequences
fields.Word_2: for no good reason: phrase indicating lack of justification
fields.Word_Example_1: He tried to avoid a task he disliked.
fields.Word_Example_2: They acted for no good reason.
fields.Word_Example_3: Despite expecting rain, we went hiking.
fields.Arabic:
التسويف هو عندما نترك مهمة قلنا أننا سنفعلها، بلا عذر مقبول،
على الرغم من توقعنا أن ذلك سيجلب لنا عواقب سلبية،
fields.Chinese_HK:
拖延症係我哋喺毫無原因之下 逃避去處理一件我哋講咗會做嘅工作
儘管明知我哋嘅行為會帶嚟負面後果
fields.Chinese_CH:
如果我们承诺完成某项任务， 也知道不完成任务会带来负面影响，
但还是无缘无故地避开这项任务， 此时的表现才是拖延症。
fields.Chinese_TW:
拖延是避而不做 說好要去做的事，
還明知行為會帶來負面的後果。
fields.French:
Procrastiner, c’est éviter une tâche qu’on a accepté de faire,
tout en sachant que notre comportement engendrera des conséquences négatives.
fields.Dutch:
Het is uitstel als je zomaar afziet van een taak die je zou gaan uitvoeren,
terwijl je weet dat je gedrag negatieve gevolgen heeft.
fields.German:
Prokrastination bedeutet, Aufgaben ohne triftigen Grund aufzuschieben,
obwohl unser Verhalten vermutlich negative Konsequenzen hat.
fields.Greek:
Αναβλητικότητα είναι όταν αποφεύγουμε να κάνουμε κάτι που έχουμε αναλάβει
παρόλο που ξέρουμε πως αυτό θα έχει αρνητικές συνέπειες.
fields.Hindi:
टालमटोल तब होती है जब हम किसी अच्छे कारण के बिना किसी कार्य को करने से बचते हैं,
भले ही हम यह उम्मीद करते हों कि हमारे व्यवहार से नकारात्मक परिणाम आएंगे।
fields.Indonesian:
Prokrastinasi adalah saat kita menghindari pekerjaan yang sudah diniati
meski kita sudah tahu kalau menunda pekerjaan itu membawa konsekuensi negatif.
fields.Italian:
La procrastinazione è evitare un impegno stabilito, senza un buon motivo,
anche se sappiamo che questo porterà conseguenze negative.
fields.Japanese:
先延ばしとは やると言った作業を 正当な理由もなく避け
それが悪い結果をもたらすと 分かっていながらも そうすることです
fields.Korean:
미룬다는 것은 해야만 하는데도 그 일을 피하는 것입니다.
우리의 행동이 나쁜 결과를 가져올 것을 알면서도요.
fields.Polish:
Prokrastynacją nazywamy moment, gdy unikamy wykonania zadania,
mimo spodziewania się, że nasze zachowanie przyniesie negatywne konsekwencje.
fields.Portuguese_BR:
A procrastinação ocorre quando evitamos uma tarefa
apesar de sabermos que nosso comportamento trará consequências negativas.
fields.Portuguese_PT:
Procrastinar é evitar uma tarefa que dissemos que íamos fazer,
embora esperemos que este comportamento resulte em consequências negativas.
fields.Russian:
Прокрастинация же — это когда мы избегаем запланированных дел,
и при этом осознаём негативные последствия нашего поведения.
fields.Spanish:
Procrastinar es cuando evitamos una tarea que planeábamos hacer, sin razón,
a pesar de que puede traernos consecuencias negativas.
fields.Thai:
การผัดวันประกันพรุ่ง คือการที่เราไม่ยอมทำ สิ่งที่เราบอกว่าจะทำ อย่างไม่มีเหตุผล
ทั้งที่รู้ว่าการทำแบบนี้จะส่งผลเสียตามมา
fields.Vietnamese:
Trì hoãn tức là tránh không làm điều ta bảo sẽ làm,
biết rằng hành vi này sẽ gây ra hậu quả xấu.

sentence: Being too hard on yourself can layer additional bad emotions onto a task, making the threat even more intense.
translation: Quá khắt khe với bản thân khiến đe dọa đáng sợ hơn.

fields.English:
Being too hard on yourself can layer additional bad emotions onto a task,
making the threat even more intense.
fields.Type: Being too hard on yourself can layer additional bad emotions onto a task making the threat even more intense
fields.Word_1: too hard on yourself: overly self-critical
fields.Word_2: layer additional: add more of something negative
fields.Word_Example_1: He was too hard on himself after the minor mistake.
fields.Word_Example_2: The new policy layered additional stress on employees.
fields.Arabic:
يمكن أن يؤدي كونك قاسيًا جدًا على نفسك إلى إضافة المزيد من المشاعر السيئة
إلى مهمة ما، مما يجعل التهديد أكثر حدة.
fields.Chinese_HK:
對自己太嚴苛， 可能會將壞情緒一層層加到工作中
令到個威脅更加強
fields.Chinese_CH:
对自己要求太苛刻会增添 任务带来的不良情绪，
从而使任务的威胁性显得更加强烈。
fields.Chinese_TW:
對自己太苛可能會把額外的 壞情緒加疊到工作任務上，
讓威脅的強度更強。
fields.French:
Être trop dur avec soi-même peut ajouter des émotions négatives à une tâche,
ce qui rend la menace encore plus forte.
fields.Dutch:
Als je te streng bent voor jezelf, stapelen zich negatieve emoties op,
waardoor het gevaar nog meer toeneemt.
fields.German:
Zu streng mit sich selbst zu sein, kann Aufgaben zusätzlich negativ belasten
und lässt so die Bedrohung noch größer erscheinen.
fields.Greek:
Το να είσαι πολύ σκληρός με τον εαυτό σου επιφέρει επιπλέον αρνητικά συναισθήματα
κάνοντας την απειλή ακόμα πιο έντονη.
fields.Hindi:
अपने आप पर बहुत अधिक कठोर होने से किसी कार्य पर अतिरिक्त बुरी भावनाएँ आ सकती हैं,
जिससे खतरा और भी तीव्र हो जाता है।
fields.Indonesian:
Bersikap terlalu keras pada diri
dan membuat ancamannya lebih mencekam.
fields.Italian:
Essere troppo duri con sé stessi può aggregare emozioni negative su un compito,
rendendo il senso della minaccia ancora più intenso.
fields.Japanese:
自分に厳しくしすぎると作業に対して 悪い感情を積み重ねるため
脅威が一層増してしまいます
fields.Korean:
본인에게 너무 엄격하면 부정적인 감정을 더 할 수 있고
일의 위협을 더 강하게 느끼게 됩니다.
fields.Polish:
Bycie zbyt surowym dla siebie może nakładać dodatkowe złe emocje na zadanie,
co sprawi, że zagrożenie stanie się jeszcze bardziej intensywne.
fields.Portuguese_BR:
Ser muito duro consigo mesmo pode sobrepor mais emoções ruins à tarefa,
tornando a ameaça ainda mais intensa.
fields.Portuguese_PT:
Se forem demasiado exigentes
o que fará com que a ameaça seja ainda mais intensa.
fields.Russian:
Слишком строгая дисциплина
и обострить восприятие надвигающейся угрозы.
fields.Spanish:
Ser muy duro contigo mismo puede agregar más emociones negativas a la tarea,
haciendo la amenaza mucho más intensa.
fields.Thai:
การเข้มงวดกับตัวเองมากไป จะทำให้เรารู้สึกแย่กับสิ่งที่ต้องทำ
ทำให้ภัยดูอันตรายมากขึ้นไปกว่าเดิม
fields.Vietnamese:
Quá khắt khe với bản thân
khiến đe dọa đáng sợ hơn.

sentence: Because of that, most water-soluble vitamins need to be replenished on a daily basis through the food we eat.
translation: Chính vì lí do đó, đa phần vitamin tan trong nước cần được hấp thụ mỗi ngày qua thức ăn.

fields.English:
Because of that, most water-soluble vitamins
need to be replenished on a daily basis through the food we eat.
fields.Type: Because of that most watersoluble vitamins need to be replenished on a daily basis through the food we eat
fields.Word_2: on a daily basis: every day
fields.Word_3: through the food we eat: by means of diet
fields.Word_Example_1: Supplies must be replenished regularly to meet demand.
fields.Word_Example_2: She exercises on a daily basis to maintain her health.
fields.Word_Example_3: We get essential minerals through the food we eat.
fields.Arabic:
ولهذا فإن معظم الفيتامينات الذائبة في الماء
تحتاج لتعويضها يوميا من خلال ما نتناوله من غذاء
fields.Chinese_CH:
正因如此 大多水溶性维他命
需要通过我们每天吃的食物 被重新补充
fields.Chinese_TW:
因此之故，大多數水溶性維他命
需要透過我們每日吃的食物來補充
fields.French:
À cause de ça, la plupart des vitamines solubles dans l'eau
doivent être réapprovisionnées quotidiennement via notre alimentation.
fields.Dutch:
Daarom moeten we de meeste wateroplosbare vitamines
dagelijks aanvullen door het voedsel dat we eten.
fields.Greek:
Γι' αυτό και οι περισσότερες υδατοδιαλυτές βιταμίνες
πρέπει να αναπληρώνονται καθημερινά μέσω της τροφής.
fields.Hindi:
जिसके कारण, इन वाटर-सोलुबल विटामिन को
हर दिन पुनः अवशोषित करना आवश्यक है, उस खाने से जिसे हम खाते है.
fields.Italian:
È per questo che quasi tutte le vitamine idrosolubili
devono essere reintegrate giornalmente tramite il cibo.
fields.Japanese:
このため 水溶性ビタミンは
日々の食事で補われる必要があります
fields.Korean:
그래서 대부분의 수용성 비타민은
음식을 통해 매일 보충해야 합니다.
fields.Polish:
Dlatego większość witamin rozpuszczalnych w wodzie
trzeba codziennie uzupełniać przez spożywane pokarmy.
fields.Portuguese_BR:
Por isso, a maioria das vitaminas hidrossolúveis
precisa ser reposta diariamente através da alimentação.
fields.Portuguese_PT:
Por causa disso, a maior parte das vitaminas hidrossolúveis
precisa de ser reposta diariamente através da comida que ingerimos.
fields.Russian:
Из-за этого большинство водорастворимых витаминов
должны пополняться ежедневно с пищей.
fields.Spanish:
Por ello, la mayoría de las vitaminas hidrosolubles
se deben reponer a diario a partir de los alimentos que ingerimos.
fields.Thai:
เพราะอย่างนั้น วิตามินที่ละลายในน้ำส่วนมาก
จึงต้องการการเติมเข้าไปใหม่ในแต่ละวัน ผ่านอาหารที่เราทาน
fields.Vietnamese:
Chính vì lí do đó, đa phần vitamin tan trong nước
cần được hấp thụ mỗi ngày qua thức ăn.

translation: Vậy ta sẽ bắt đầu từ đâu?

fields.Word_1: where do you begin: used to ask how or where to start when something seems complex
fields.Word_Example_1: Faced with so many challenges, where do you begin?
fields.Japanese: では どこから始めれば 良いでしょうか？
fields.Vietnamese: Vậy ta sẽ bắt đầu từ đâu?

sentence: Thanks to your deductive reasoning, order is restored to the galaxy.
translation: Nhờ tư duy diễn dịch của bạn, trật tự đã được lập lại trên dải ngân hà.

fields.English: Thanks to your deductive reasoning, order is restored to the galaxy.
fields.Type: Thanks to your deductive reasoning order is restored to the galaxy
fields.Word_1: thanks to: because of, with positive cause
fields.Word_2: deductive reasoning: logical process using known facts to reach conclusions
fields.Word_3: is restored: something returns to its original or proper state
fields.Word_Example_1: Thanks to your help, we finished ahead of schedule.
fields.Word_Example_2: Detectives use deductive reasoning to solve complex cases.
fields.Word_Example_3: Peace was restored after the negotiations ended.
fields.Arabic: بفضل المنطق الاستنتاجي الخاص بك، يتم استعادة النظام إلى المجرة.
fields.Chinese_CH: 由于你的推理逻辑， 宇宙秩序得以维持。
fields.Chinese_TW: 感謝你的推理，銀河恢復了秩序。
fields.French: Grâce à votre esprit de déduction, l'ordre est rétabli dans la galaxie.
fields.German: Dank deines deduktiven Denkens wird die Ordnung in der Galaxie wiederhergestellt.
fields.Indonesian: Berkat penalaran deduktifmu, galaksi kembali tertib.
fields.Japanese: あなたの演繹的な考え方のおかげで 再び銀河に秩序がもたらされました
